limitations_and_boundaries: The paper does not report wet-lab validation of predicted perturbation effects.
The study is limited to the three datasets (RPE1, K562, Norman) and may not generalize to other cell types or perturbation types.
The model requires pre-trained gene embeddings (Gene2Vec) which may not be available for all organisms or gene sets.
The paper does not provide confidence intervals or statistical significance tests for the performance improvements over baselines.
The causal evidence chain is limited to computational prediction; no experimental perturbation or rescue experiments are performed.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

Develop AttentionPert, a multi-level deep-learning method integrating multi-head attention with graph neural networks on augmented gene interactions and pre-trained co-expressive gene representations.
Evaluate AttentionPert on RPE1, K562, and Norman datasets for predicting post-perturbation gene expression shifts.
Perform ablation studies to assess contribution of PertWeight, PertLocal, Gene2Vec initialization, and NA-bias module.

methods.name: AttentionPert
methods.protocol_description: AttentionPert takes perturbation condition c as input, represented as binary indicator vector zc. It feeds zc into PertWeight and PertLocal encoders, each outputting a matrix of encoding (HPW and HPL) of shape K x D. A gene-specific decoder sums the two encodings and generates predicted post-perturbation expression shift gθ(c). The shift is added to a random control sample xic to obtain predicted post-perturbation expression ŷθ(c)i = gθ(c) + xic. The model is trained using a combined auto-focus and direction-aware loss function. Gene embeddings are initialized with Gene2Vec pre-trained co-expression representations. PertWeight uses attention to learn weight matrices representing nonuniform gene-to-gene perturbational effects. PertLocal captures localized gene perturbation effects and includes an NA-bias module to model nonadditive effects of multi-gene perturbations.
